patch_description: This design keeps the strongest observed inductive biases: a collective basis rotation, parameter-free Möbius connectivity, and strict translation symmetry. It removes the current ansatz’s second circuit parameter, restoring the three-total-parameter economy of the best prior candidates. The novel component is an edgewise interleaving of tied ZZ and YY interactions. Each YY gate immediately follows its corresponding ZZ gate and shares the same collective angle used by every other parametrized gate. This adds orthogonal correlation channels at zero parameter cost, while overlapping ring edges and repeated collective RY layers generate noncommuting dynamics. The resulting one-dimensional circuit trajectory should regularize few-shot training while offering richer correlator transformation for the hardest validation groups.
